final_original_reference_raw_fidelity.quantization_scope: Existing restored models are reused and byte-bound to their restoration receipt. The existing restoration quantizer is identified; no conversion or quantization is run here.
final_original_reference_raw_fidelity.scope: Model-owned recurrent-weight-cache candidate: six fresh native C API scnet_diff workers, 0.25-second raw probes against restored original F32 captures; all 35 stages.

limits: The private cast/scheduling controls alone do not compare against PyTorch. The subsequent separate 0.25-second raw probes compare all35 stages against the restored original F32 captures.
Neither short control set exercises the full default overlapping chunk/shift pipeline.
No timings are recorded and no speed improvement or overall qualification is established.
The observer preserves graph splitting and forwards the actual callback; atomic counting and duplicate planning still make it diagnostic instrumentation, not a timing benchmark.
The mapped-library endpoints and resolved CBLAS symbol owner do not constitute continuous mapping surveillance or complete call-site relocation proof.
Scalar/no-BLAS/GPU guard routing was reviewed, not exercised by these runtime controls.
The additional cache occupies exactly 15 MiB for SCNet and 60 MiB for SCNet-large, per loaded native context.

private_harness.cast_oracle: An actual ggml_cast(source,F32) CPU graph is executed for every recurrent matrix; every resulting byte is compared with the model-owned F32 leaf. SHA256 records supplement, rather than replace, the full byte comparisons.
private_harness.description: The executed private control includes the exact native SCNet translation unit with canonical flags and links the same core/ggml/provider. It does not link a duplicate libscnet.a object.
private_harness.immutability: After both native calls, original tensor identity/data pointer/type/shape/hash and cached F32 payload hashes are checked against their initial values. Per-tensor after hashes are checked internally; the retained complete event records the successful aggregate check.
private_harness.observer: The private wrapper forwards the existing CPU backend graph_compute on its natural splits, duplicates planning only for reporting, and temporarily wraps recurrence fun/userdata with atomic counters. It forwards the unchanged ith/nth to the original callback and restores all op_params bytes under RAII. No scheduler evaluation callback or BENCH instrumentation is enabled.

ordinary_and_observed_calls.output_comparison: Every complete stem is compared byte-for-byte in the private harness; the observed output is retained.

scope: Six model/precision correctness and scheduling controls: 144 real CPU ggml_cast comparisons and 72 natural BENCH=0 recurrent callback observations, followed by six original-F32-reference raw probes covering all 210 stages. No full-pipeline or performance qualification.
